transcript: Speaker A: 2026 lagbhag aadha saal beet gaya. Kya tum English ke teen naye shabd bhi seekh paye? Dekho, English seekhna mushkil nahi hai, mushkil hai shuru karna. Toh aaj shuru karo, English Seekho app download karo. Do hafte ka challenge lo, roz sirf 15 minute. Pehla hafta, experts ke videos dekho. Spoken English show hai, Hindi mein samjha ke English bolna sikhate hain, basic se start hoga. Hello, thank you, excuse me yahan se. Chhote do-paanch minute ke videos. Itne aasaan ki lagega ye toh mujhe bhi aa sakta hai. Dusra hafta, AI coach ke saath practice karo. 24 ghante available hain AI coach. Subah 5 baje bhi, raat ke 12 baje bhi. Jo expert ke video mein seekha, woh AI coach ke saath bol ke practice karo. Galat bologe, sudhaar dengi. Pronunciation galat hai, pakad lengi. Tense galat lagaya, bata dengi. 100 baar galat bolo, 100 baar sudhaar dengi. Kabhi hasengi nahi, kabhi judge nahi karengi, kabhi nahi bolengi 'itna bhi nahi aata tumhe'. Aur sabse badi baat, kisi stranger se baat nahi karni. Kisi ajnabi ke saamne galat English bol ke sharmana nahi hai. Tum aur AI coach, bas. Private, safe, tumhari speed se. 14 din mein kya hoga? English perfect nahi hogi, jhoot nahi bolungi. Par itna hoga ki tum bol paoge. Bina ruke, bina dare, bina sharmaye. Aur wahi kaafi hai shuru karne ke liye. Experts sikhayein, AI coach ke saath practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupya. No bahana, sirf practice. English Seekho app download karo. [2026 is almost half over. Did you even learn three new English words? Look, learning English isn't hard; starting is. So start today, download the English Seekho app. Take a two-week challenge, just 15 minutes daily. First week, watch expert videos. It's a spoken English show that teaches English by explaining in Hindi, starting from the basics like Hello, Thank You, Excuse Me. Short 2-5 minute videos, so easy you'll feel you can do it too. Second week, practice with an AI coach available 24/7. Even at 5 AM or 12 midnight. Practice speaking what you learned from the expert videos with the AI coach. If you speak incorrectly, she will correct you. If pronunciation is wrong, she'll catch it. If you use the wrong tense, she'll tell you. Speak wrong 100 times, she'll correct you 100 times. She will never laugh, never judge, and never say 'you don't even know this much'. And best of all, no need to talk to strangers or feel embarrassed speaking wrong English in front of them. Just you and the AI coach. Private, safe, at your own pace. What will happen in 14 days? Your English won't be perfect, I won't lie. But you will be able to speak without stopping, without fear, and without embarrassment, which is enough to start. Experts teach, practice with the AI coach. Trial for just 1 rupee. No excuses, just practice. Download the English Seekho app.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
